name: Genesys Cloud CX
description: Genesys Cloud CX is an enterprise contact-center-as-a-service (CCaaS) platform unifying contact center, digital channels, workforce engagement, and AI orchestration across voice and digital customer interactions.
best_for: Large enterprises wanting a single platform for contact center, digital channels, and workforce management, with published named/concurrent/hourly per-user pricing across four tiers.
features: AI orchestration loop ("Perceive, Reason, Act, Optimize, Govern") coordinating AI agents and human teams across interactions
Multi-channel support across voice, email, web chat, SMS, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, X direct messages, and Apple Messages for Business, with context preserved across channels
Virtual agents designed to provide always-on, multilingual automated service
Enterprise integrations with platforms like Salesforce and ServiceNow, plus hundreds of business systems via AppFoundry and open APIs
AI Experience tokens bundled per tier for copilots, real-time guidance, and personalized employee development
Four published pricing tiers (Genesys Cloud CX 1-4) scaling from voice-only to omnichannel with advanced AI
pros: Publishes four named per-user pricing tiers ($75-$240/user/month) rather than requiring a quote to see any number
Genesys reports its platform processes 29 billion real-time conversations annually, per its own site
cons: Quality management (CX 2), workforce engagement (CX 3), and advanced AI (CX 4) each require stepping up a tier -- the entry CX 1 tier covers voice-only contact centers
AI Experience tokens are capped per organization/month (250 named/350 concurrent included) with additional tokens purchased separately

tiers.name: Genesys Cloud CX 1
tiers.notes: Named-license pricing for voice-only contact centers.

tiers.name: Genesys Cloud CX 2
tiers.notes: Adds omnichannel support with quality assurance (QA).

tiers.name: Genesys Cloud CX 4
tiers.notes: Adds advanced AI and journey management, plus 30 AI Experience tokens per named agent. Concurrent and Hourly Interacting licensing are also available as alternatives to named licensing.

alternatives.name: Five9
alternatives.description: A cloud contact-center-as-a-service (CCaaS) platform for inbound, outbound, and blended customer engagement across voice and digital channels, built around its Genius AI suite.
alternatives.best_for: Contact centers wanting published bundle pricing and a dedicated Genius AI product line as an alternative to Genesys Cloud CX.
strengths: Published Digital ($119/seat/mo) and Core ($159/seat/mo) bundle pricing
Genius AI Agents, Agent Assist, and GenAI Studio
Omnichannel support across voice, email, chat, social, and SMS

alternatives.name: Talkdesk
alternatives.description: A cloud contact center platform combining traditional contact-center software with autonomous, orchestrated AI agents for specific customer-experience tasks.
alternatives.best_for: Contact centers wanting published per-agent pricing tiers plus a no-contract small-business plan as an alternative to Genesys Cloud CX.
strengths: Published per-user pricing from $85-$225/month across four tiers
Talkdesk Express: 25 licenses plus $100 credit with no contract, for businesses under 50 employees
Autonomous multi-agent AI orchestration for specific CX tasks

alternatives.name: RingCentral
alternatives.description: A cloud communications platform (RingEX) that also offers RingCX, an omnichannel AI-powered contact center, alongside its core phone, video, and messaging suite.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting contact-center capability bundled inside a broader unified-communications platform rather than a dedicated, standalone CCaaS product.
strengths: RingCX omnichannel contact center with AI-powered quality management
Published per-user pricing from $20-$35/month for the core UC suite

faq.question: Does Genesys Cloud CX offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Genesys's own pricing page does not mention a free trial; instead it offers named-license, concurrent, and hourly-interacting billing options across four published per-user tiers.
